memos.headline: Phase 1b data out at 03:17 ET; ORIC opened -3.8% and is -2.9%: the market did not buy 'best-in-class'
reasoning: Primary source: ORIC's release on GlobeNewswire, 'ORIC Pharmaceuticals Presents Potential Best-in-Class Data for Enozertinib in 1L NSCLC Patients with EGFR Atypical Mutations at ESMO Congress 2026 and Plans to Advance Enozertinib to Phase 3'. First on Benzinga at 07:17 UTC.

Quoted: 'an 84% confirmed systemic objective response rate (ORR) by investigator and 80% by blinded independent central review'; '65% of patients had baseline brain metastases'; Phase 3 'Redwood-1' planned for 1H 2027.
What changed: strong single-arm response rates in a niche (atypical EGFR mutations) and a Phase 3 that starts next year. Response rates are not survival, and the registrational readout is years away.
Already traded: ORIC opened 13.10 (-3.8% vs 13.62) and is 13.225 (-2.9%) on 46,020 IEX shares by midday.
objections: Phase 1b data released before the open; the market sold it.

memos.headline: ORIC: no trade. 84% response rate in Phase 1b; stock -2.9% on it
reasoning: Enozertinib, first-line NSCLC with atypical EGFR mutations: 84% investigator / 80% BICR confirmed ORR; Phase 3 in 1H 2027.
Same pattern as the other ESMO updates: early data with high response rates are sold, not bought, on the day.
objections: Phase 1b data released before the open; the market sold it.
